findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "New" (pill) above "Power Agency Growth Through Partners"; "How It Works" (pill) above "Three Steps to Growth"; "Features" (pill) above "Why Agencies Choose Us"; "Testimonials" (pill) above "Loved by Agencies Worldwide"; "FAQ" (pill) above "Frequently Asked Questions"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "Step 01", "Step 02", "Step 03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 27 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "New", "Main", "Total Revenue", "Active Partners").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ★ ⚡
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 6 gradient fill(s): div.flex-1.bg-gradient-to-br → linear-gradient(to right bottom in oklab, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0%, rgb(253, 253, 253) 100%) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to top in oklab, rgb(253, 253, 253) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 100%) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to right bottom in oklab, rgb(255, 245, 235) 0%, rgb(255, 251, 245) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 35 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.inline-flex.items-center → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button.w-full.sm:w-auto → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button.w-full.sm:w-auto → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 3 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.w-[240px].bg-[#FCFCFA] 240px | div.max-w-6xl.mx-auto 1152px | div.border-t.border-white/10 1152px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 25 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 13 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 3 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 6, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Floating rounded pill navigation.
findings.fix: Use a plain bar: wordmark left, a few links, one action.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #f6f3ec).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Step 01" 2.3:1 (#99a1af on #f6f3ec); "Step 02" 2.3:1 (#99a1af on #f6f3ec); "Step 03" 2.3:1 (#99a1af on #f6f3ec); "High" 2.5:1 (#ff6b6b on #fef2f2)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (6.7:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (1 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 109 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 27 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 165px on the left, 188px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Power Agency Growth Through Partners" → 3 lines (5 words, 80px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "Verified Partners" (1px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
